estimator: Deterministic exact FIFO inventory/cash attribution and descriptive original-attempt coverage only; no fitted model, thresholds, trained probability, ranking or financial authority.
inputs: Operator-pinned sealed original live bank manifest, full native event-prefix chain and original ordinary dispatch-prefix chain. No active files, invented receipt, account request, detached live Session or inferred fill. Replay starts from the original bank seed; adoption is consumed as original inherited lots and never relabeled new trading.
eligibility: An ordinary original BUY attempt with immutable original intent, genuine original POST ACK received strictly before actual execution, no package/review/exit metadata, matched native actual binding and original actual fill identity. All other captured holdings still participate in FIFO/own-depth accounting; their gains are not ordinary-maker alpha.
attemptDenominator: Every original attempted ordinary BUY, including pending unknown, partial, full and complete-terminal zero-fill. Zero-fill is only an actual native terminal with fillsComplete=true, exact filledQuantity=0 and matching original dispatch closed/ACK evidence. Cancellation ACK, expiry time, order absence or missing fills is not zero-fill proof. Early terminal zero is descriptive, never probability of filling an unchanged full exposure window.
fifo: Apply original native accepted-event order, not hindsight execution-time resorting. Track exact lot identity/quantity/basis/entry fee/execution and first-observed clocks. SELL consumes same-side FIFO; opposite BUY consumes opposite FIFO with actual one-unit netting cash and frozen buy price, then opens only residual quantity. Native accepted order remains authoritative when older fills arrive late. Label this accepted-FIFO behavior rather than claiming venue reconstruction.
fees: Integer micro-unit principal and exact rational proportional fee allocation. Explicit recorded fees remain source-attributed, not independently inferred venue charges. Missing entry/exit fees keep gross amounts separate and net marked/realized unknown; never substitute zero. Future exit fee is unknown for every hypothetical mark, so net hypothetical profit is never claimed.
labelUnit: One exchange/side flat-to-flat inventory episode, which may contain several partial fills/attempts. At every source event recompute deadline from oldest remaining eligible ordinary new lot plus60000ms. If an older lot is actually consumed before deadline, retarget to the actual next oldest remaining lot without resetting any lot clock. Inherited-only inventory has no new-entry age clock. Mixed inherited/review/package exposure is marked mixed, not qualified as pure ordinary maker.
firstHorizonBook: For an unlabelled episode take the first genuinely accepted matching full book whose original source and receipt clocks are at or after its current oldest-lot deadline and no later than deadline+5000ms. Book request/source/receipt/processing clocks must be original, nonfuture and fresh within10000ms. Freeze the exposure as actually known when this book is processed. Never wait for the last partial to complete. A stale/shallow/late/invalid first candidate cannot be replaced by a later favorable candidate.
lateAndContinuity: Any fill learned after its age deadline, or with an execution clock earlier than an already frozen episode label, invalidates that episode's mark rather than silently rewriting it or selecting a later target. A gap/reset during the exposure censors its path even after a later full snapshot recovers. Original explicit complete coverage must span the oldest execution through label source; without it mark is coverage_unavailable. No historical book is retroactively made actionable.
depth: Remove all known physical own remaining liquidity, including acknowledged-but-not-authoritatively-terminal orders and residual unknown attempts, from their exact price levels. Known complete actual terminal/positive proved-before-network not implemented here is never inferred from native retired alone. Walk YES bids or complement YES asks for NO. Require full current episode exposure depth for a full mark; report supported shares/partial proceeds separately. Also report native50%-top-depth exit slice capacity, never pretend inventoryAON is venue atomic execution.
realized: Record only actual FIFO matched SELL or opposite-BUY netting outcomes from accepted original actual fills. Realized amounts attach to the original consumed lot/episode, and new fees are allocated once. Episode may close before its age deadline and then has realized-only status, not a fabricated horizon mark. Partial actual closes do not dispose of the remaining marked inventory. Settlement/collateral inventory changes are unsupported and fail closed, not unexplained wallet absence.
restart: Restart by replaying the exact pinned original prefixes. No deserialized projection can authorize trading or erase unknown attempts; repeated actual fill IDs are idempotent only when economic facts match. Conflicts or chain/scope/clock contradictions reject the analysis. Snapshots, marks and actual realized totals are separate derived research output.
statistics: Report original attempt outcomes, FIFO episodes, mark availability/depth/fee/continuity/late-observation categories, actual realized gross/net-known, age-to-label and execution-to-observation latency. No fill probability estimate from early cancellations, no independent-sample claim for multiple fills in one episode, no hypothetical avoided loss, no counterfactual fill or profit. All thresholds/horizons above are fixed before outcome analysis.
